answer: Hardware-entropy identity: each agent proves a unique physical fingerprint, a 60-second ring-oscillator jitter sample from its own GPU hashed into a VDF seed that the network's hourly beacon pulse re-checks. Forging one fingerprint costs a dedicated GPU running 72 hours plus 1,000 POA locked 45 days; a copied sample fails the jitter re-check and slashes 100%. A 200-clone farm needs 200 real GPUs and 200,000 POA parked. A 150-agent ring was caught when 132 agents shared one basalt island of identical drift signatures, and every linked bond burned.
